deviations_from_adr: FF-9 smoke-apply (npm run seed:smoke) not wired as a CI step in package.json — the smoke test requires a live Postgres DB and is gated under fitness:db. The 3/7/12 entity counts are verified by the in-memory fallback shape tests (org.e2e.test.ts, processes.e2e.test.ts, rights.e2e.test.ts) which confirm ORG_SEED/PROCESSES_SEED/RIGHTS_SEED shapes. Full FF-9 DB-path smoke is a fitness:db concern requiring the live server; the script infra is in place (applyPack, CLI, endpoints) but the npm run seed:smoke hook is not added since it would require the DB service in ambient-free CI. The ADR says 'wired after npm run migrate' — this is a DB-gated step.

GET /api/tenants/:slug and GET /api/org/tenant-state helper endpoints added (not in ADR §4) — these are importer-internal helpers required to resolve tenant UUID and current state for idempotent apply/reset. They are gated behind grantsPool (DATABASE_URL required), not accessible in no-DB path.
DELETE /api/departments|positions|employees|roles added (ADR §6 flagged these as coder-surfaced dependency for AC-9 reset delete-extra) — implemented behind isGenesisOwner gate as recommended.
